reason: A browser-side dsh web plugin that groups and collapses think blocks and tool cards while preserving message text and adapting to light and dark themes.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 dsh Web 客户端的界面插件，可将 Think 推理块和工具卡片合并为可展开的内联折叠块。
summaries.en: A dsh Web client interface plugin that groups Think blocks and tool cards into expandable inline collapsed sections.

capabilities: Modifies the web client DOM presentation of chat messages
Hides and reveals tool cards and think blocks through browser-side styling
Observes chat view mutations to maintain the collapsed state
Injects clickable inline collapse controls into the chat flow
